title: Kusikiliza kwa Kutathmini (Theme 15: Maadili ya kitaifa)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child plans what to say, listens to the end, and replies on the topic in standard Kiswahili with the features of a kutathmini.
steps: Reply on the topic with a reason.
Keep the language and the turn-taking right.

board.do: mchango wa vijana katika kudumisha amani
Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child takes part in a short kutathmini on the topic while a partner ticks the checklist.

misconceptions.ask: Ushahidi wa hoja hii ni upi?
misconceptions.repair: Tathmini hoja kwa ushahidi kabla ya kukubali.

misconceptions.ask: Ungekubali hoja hii kama ingesemwa na mtu mwingine?

checks.question: Mzungumzaji anasema: "Kila mtu anajua dawa hii hutibu magonjwa yote." Ufanye nini?
checks.answer: kuuliza ushahidi na chanzo cha habari hiyo
